userStories.title: Define engine transcript contracts
userStories.description: As a workflow engine maintainer, I want canonical transcript and pending-interaction schemas plus a narrow store capability, so that every layer shares one type-safe contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/workflows/src/schemas/node-message.ts with strict Zod discriminated text, tool, and status variants. Row identity requires non-empty id, workflow_run_id, node_id, positive integer seq, and Date-or-string created_at; append input omits id, seq, and created_at.

The text payload accepts only non-empty text; the tool payload accepts non-empty name and id with optional unknown input/output; the status payload accepts any non-empty state with optional detail. Tests prove kind/payload correlation and reject invalid identity while accepting a future status note.

Create packages/workflows/src/schemas/pending-interaction.ts with exactly id, workflow_run_id, node_id, tool_use_id, kind ask|permission, status pending|answered|purged, envelope Record<string, unknown>, nullable answer Record<string, unknown>, provider_session_id, created_at, resolved_at, and resolved_by. Tests reject forked enum values.
Use z from @hono/zod-openapi, z.infer for all new types, strict objects, and z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()). Re-export both modules from schemas/index.ts.

Add only IWorkflowNodeMessageStore with appendNodeMessage(input) and listNodeMessages(workflowRunId, nodeId), then compose it into IWorkflowStore at packages/workflows/src/store.ts:213 without changing existing members.

Update every concrete typed IWorkflowStore double named by the plan, including in-memory sequencing/filtering in subrun.test.ts, so workflow type checking passes. Keep intentional plannotator unknown casts unchanged.
Put both schema tests in the existing mock-safe schema invocation in packages/workflows/package.json; run their RED/GREEN sequence and the focused workflow type/test commands successfully.

userStories.title: Persist ordered transcript rows safely
userStories.description: As the workflow runtime, I want validated append and list persistence for node messages, so that transcript timelines are durable, ordered, and safe to inspect.
acceptanceCriteria: Create core workflow-node-message schema as an alias of nodeMessageSchema with its type inferred by z.infer, and re-export it from packages/core/src/schemas/index.ts.
Create workflow-node-messages DB module with appendNodeMessage, listNodeMessages, isNodeMessageSequenceConflict, WorkflowNodeMessageCorruptRowError, and fixed-column row normalization.

Append validates input, uses a transaction to calculate MAX(seq)+1 per workflow_run_id/node_id, generates a dialect id, JSON-stringifies payload, inserts, rereads, validates the row, and returns the parsed NodeMessage.

On an adopted sequence conflict, retry exactly once in a new transaction. PostgreSQL classification requires code 23505 and uq_workflow_node_messages_run_node_seq; SQLite classification requires all three fully-qualified transcript unique columns. Unrelated unique violations must not retry.

List filters by both identity fields and orders ascending by seq. SQLite tests prove independent node sequences, ordered list, cascade deletion, concurrent Promise.all append sequences 1 and 2, and exact positive/negative conflict classifiers.

A malformed JSON payload or invalid normalized row logs only row id and a fixed reason, throws WorkflowNodeMessageCorruptRowError containing only the row id, and never logs payload content. Tests use a sentinel secret to prove redaction.

Export both a workflowNodeMessageDb namespace and direct symbols from packages/core/src/db/index.ts. Place the process-global connection mock test in its own core package test invocation and pass focused test plus type check.
Commit this slice with message feat(core): persist workflow node transcripts.

Follow existing db namespace style at packages/core/src/db/index.ts:22. The real SQLite test must seed foreign-key run parents. This is plan Task 3 steps 1-6.

userStories.title: Record command and prompt transcripts
userStories.description: As an operator, I want command and prompt node output captured in provider order, so that a node's transcript accurately replays its work.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend the executor mock store to retain append inputs with sequences. Table-driven command and prompt stream tests prove the exact stored sequence started, text, tool, text, completed and exact tool payload name Read, id tool-1, input path a.ts.
A batch-delivery regression test proves an assistant text transcript row precedes a following tool row even if platform batching flushes text later, with no duplicate final-batch text row.

In executeNodeInternal, append started after scheduling node_started; append every non-empty assistant chunk before batching; append one tool row after stable/anonymous tool id selection and only when tool input exists; append completed after scheduled node_completed.
Record failed after scheduled node_failed for command-load, prompt substitution, cancellation, credit exhaustion, empty-output, and catch paths. Use exact node error strings as failed detail.

Move output-reference substitution into its existing prompt failure handling and turn provider lookup failure into the same failed NodeExecutionResult/event/emitter path so both receive a failed transcript note.
Tests cover command-load error, invalid output reference, provider lookup error, normal exactly-one completed terminal, and a rejecting transcript store that does not prevent workflow completion.
Preserve existing event/emitter order and do not record tool_result or any unsupported node type. Pass dag-executor tests and workflows type check.

Use node state name labels for normal rows, name ×iteration for loop rows, and name #executionSeq for route rows. Use event ids for repeated iteration/route row identity, with the latest lifecycle or stable node id fallback for ordinary rows.
